title: Bringing Cassandra Back
summary: Cassandra de Rolo fell to a dragon at Kraghammer and her soul lingers in limbo — about six days remain. Her body now rests in Pelor's chapel, and the Raven Queen's shadar-kai have named the cleric who can complete the rite: Pike Trickfoot, beneath the Temple of Sarenrae, who must drive Mortis's diamond through her chest as a catalyst.

title: Pelor's Charge
summary: Pelor set Sorfon to carry the sealed censer of incense some seven kilometres across Vasselheim, from the Temple of Pelor to the Temple of Sarenrae, and to guard the surviving de Rolos. The custodian Marco has granted the party pilgrim rites and taken Cassandra's body in; the incense is still undelivered, and Tyr's new plate is still to be collected.

title: The Raven Queen's Thread
summary: A golden thread from Mortis's patron keeps singling out what he needs — it led him to Greyskull Keep and, in Vasselheim, to the scroll of Speak with Dead. Prayed to at the palace shrine of all gods, she answered through her shadar-kai and gave up Pike's hiding place. What she ultimately wants of Mortis remains open; her priests reach her by dying willingly, and he is spared that.

title: Hunted and Watched
summary: An invisible imp spying at Ubu's feet named its master: La Toma, the Slayer's Take, a monster-hunter guild quartered in the war district — and they are hunting Mortis. Since Sorfon bought their dampir prisoner off them, they hunt Locus too; the contract lifts only once their leader Ocisa (?) is dealt with.

title: The Redeemed Dampir
summary: La Toma seized a white-haired dampir named Locus out of the crowd on the main avenue; Sorfon paid the orc Hungar (?) the 200 gp bounty to claim him, meaning to redeem rather than kill him. Baba Yaga's book names him the last living subject of a Strahd and Baba Yaga line bred as vampire monster-hunters, and he is bound by a Geas. The plan is to slip him out of the city.

title: The Axe and the Corrupted Dragon
summary: Bahamut explained why the ancient black dragon Haftifaflmorhen keeps appearing: tricked by Torog (?) and forced to devour his best friend, he is a maddened victim who hunts the Baxcazhak. The Platinum Dragon refused to take the axe off their hands: it stays under guard in Kraghammer, but Ereldra can call it to her as her pact weapon, so the party still answers for it and tells no one where it lies — the more so because her patron Ashardalon would be served by it. Peace comes only when the axe returns to its maker.

title: The Patron in the Hoard
summary: Mid-crossing the ancient red dragon Ashardalon reached Ereldra from atop a vast hoard, claiming her as patron and demanding to know why the party strayed from Whitestone. She professes loyalty while serving the patron's true objective, bound up with the de Rolo line.

title: The Debt to Allura
summary: After Allura Vysoren bound the ghostly Mortis and named the party his wardens, they owe her a mission to repair the damage done to Greyskull Keep. The nature of that mission has not yet been revealed.

title: The Lost Temple of Sarenrae
summary: Sorfon came to Tal'Dorei hunting the ancient temple where his mother trained. Sarenrae, angered by his lifelong devotion to Pelor alone, gave only a riddle: 'The temple is just a temple; follow YOUR light.'

title: Ayante's Aristeia
summary: Sent abroad from Ilión, Ayante seeks the great deed his city will remember, and records every step of the journey in a codex to be delivered home. He believes his aristeia lies somewhere along Sorfon's road.

title: The Meeting with Bahamut
summary: The white-robed man from the crossroads, the Archon who governs Vasselheim this cycle, revealed himself at the palace gate as Bahamut, the Platinum Dragon. He named Haftifaflmorhen a victim of Torog (?), recalled the Calamity and his lost companion Cromulus (?), declined to accept the Baxcazhak, and told Sorfon and Ereldra to keep its location secret for now.

title: Delivering the Barûk-Kazad
summary: The party returned the legendary dwarven axe to Kraghammer and escorted Cassandra's body from the ruined palace, claiming both bounties for 4,800 gp. Sorfon was named Emissary of Kraghammer. The axe stayed behind under guard — though it is Ereldra's pact weapon, and she can summon it to her hand wherever she is.

title: Caval's Grave and the Witch's Book
summary: Ereldra found Caval's grave in the crypt and Mortis told her of his betrayer. Above ground the party settled Baba Yaga's book — bound in skin, clasped with teeth — stowing it in the bag of holding rather than burning it back to the witch.

title: The Pact Beneath the Sun
summary: At Gilmore's shop in Emon, Ayante overheard Sorfon asking after an ancient temple. Mockery gave way to respect once he learned Sorfon served Pelor, and the two devotees sealed a pact bare-armed beneath the noon sun.
